audit_verify_nested_flag_screen_loso.classification_evidence: Same held-out delta as the fixed served set (+2.395); positive in all six held-out seasons; decisive record 286-248 on 534 games; within-week flag-shuffle null over 200 draws mean +0.09 sd 0.62 max +2.33 so observed sits above every draw. Interval crosses zero at 95% so not terminal; no closing ground applies.
audit_verify_nested_flag_screen_loso.description: Nested leave-one-season-out check of the served four-term probability: flag membership re-screened on the five training seasons only (keep flags with training delta above zero among the nine candidates), one flag_sum coefficient refit per fold, scored on the held-out season; paired delta vs raw model pick (p at or above 0.5)
audit_verify_nested_flag_screen_loso.notes: Answers the 2026-09-15 audit's model-selection finding for the SERVED path: selection among the nine coded candidates does not inflate the held-out number. Does not cover selection of the nine from the wider look history or in-sample tuning of flag definitions. Correlated with four_term_probability_* rows; never pool as independent.
audit_verify_nested_flag_screen_loso.plain_summary: When the card's extra situational flags are chosen using only past seasons and then tested on a season they never saw, the picks still land about two and a half games per hundred ahead of the raw model. That is a fair check, not a number tuned on the games it was scored on.
